codex.norse.name: Norse Codex
codex.norse.shortDescription: Weathered stone, forged iron, restrained knotwork, and the permanent Base Rune Script.
codex.norse.longDescription: The permanent founding Codex of Rune Scribe. Norse is always installed, always owned, and always available as the secure presentation fallback.

script.base-runes.name: Base Rune Script
script.base-runes.description: Rune Scribe’s original 32-symbol Unicode-portable visual alphabet.

relic.norse.runestone.weathered.name: Weathered Rune Stone
relic.norse.runestone.weathered.description: A broad weathered stone canvas framed in forged iron and restrained knotwork. The dependable Norse surface for short and long inscriptions.

relic.norse.raven-medallion.name: Raven Medallion
relic.norse.raven-medallion.description: A circular forged medallion with a pale stone face and raven crest, intended for concise messages.

relic.norse.ironbound-shield.name: Ironbound Round Shield
relic.norse.ironbound-shield.description: A round wooden shield reinforced with iron, with a protected central field for compact inscriptions.

relic.norse.sealed-parchment.name: Sealed Parchment
relic.norse.sealed-parchment.description: A wide sheet of aged parchment held by forged fittings and a raven seal, optimized for longer messages.

relic.norse.runestone.blackstone.name: Blackstone Rune Stone
relic.norse.runestone.blackstone.description: A ceremonial black stone tablet crossed by restrained gold and blue forge-light cracks, awarded for Norse mastery.

relic.norse.runestone.frozen.name: Frozen Rune Stone
relic.norse.runestone.frozen.description: A pale rune stone edged with frost and ice, reserved for a separately approved winter Season challenge.

seal.norse.knotwork.name: Knotwork Mark
seal.norse.knotwork.description: An interlaced gold knot surrounding a small blue center stone.

seal.norse.forge-flame.name: Forge Flame
seal.norse.forge-flame.description: A gold forge flame with a restrained blue inner flame.

seal.norse.raven.name: Raven Seal
seal.norse.raven.description: A silver raven in profile on a dark forged medallion.

seal.norse.longship.name: Longship Seal
seal.norse.longship.description: A longship above a single blue wave, representing sustained correspondence.

seal.norse.forge-hammer.name: Forge Hammer Seal
seal.norse.forge-hammer.description: A forged hammer with a small blue spark.

seal.norse.echo-rune.name: Echo Rune Seal
seal.norse.echo-rune.description: A central rune between expanding gold and blue echo arcs, earned through incoming Norse-presented messages.

frame.norse.carved-knotwork.name: Carved Knotwork Frame
frame.norse.carved-knotwork.description: A carved silver-and-gold knotwork border with restrained corner ornaments.

crest.norse.forge-master.name: Forge Master Crest
crest.norse.forge-master.description: A shield-shaped crest showing an anvil, blue flame, and paired silver wings.

requirements.achievement.correspondent: Establish your first bidirectional cipher relationship.
requirements.rule.codex.norse.echo-five: Decode five valid incoming messages presented with the Norse Codex.
requirements.rule.codex.norse.mastery: Complete the approved Norse mastery requirements.
requirements.rule.season.winter.frozen-runestone: Reserved for a future approved winter Season challenge.
